whenToUse: A private office or luxury agency for exceptional homes with full-bleed film, a collection and floor-plan room views.
Agencies offering off-market registers and private-viewing requests.
avoidWhen: Everyday apartment listings with a map — use site-estate-01.
A wedding or event venue — use site-venue-01.
a11y: Crossfades stop under prefers-reduced-motion; the lightbox and floor plan support the keyboard and announce changes via aria-live.
Write real alt text for every room photograph; the placeholders use empty alt.
